name: openroom

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

description: An open-source investor data room: email sign-in links, folder-by-folder access, stamped documents, view tracking. One click on Cloudflare, or Docker on your own server.

APP_ORIGIN.description: Your room's address. Leave empty to use the free `*.workers.dev` address Cloudflare gives you. Set it later if you add your own domain, for example `https://dataroom.example.com`.

ADMIN_EMAILS.description: Who can manage the room: one email, or several separated by commas. Each one signs in with a link sent to that address.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Sign-in links go out by email. Create a free account at [resend.com](https://resend.com), then copy an API key from **API Keys**. Using Amazon SES instead? Leave this empty and see the README.

MAIL_FROM.description: Who sign-in emails come from. `onboarding@resend.dev` only reaches the email you signed up to Resend with. To email investors, verify your domain in Resend and use an address on it, like `Data Room <rooms@yourdomain.com>`.

BRAND_NAME.description: Your company name. You can change it, and add your logo and colours, later on the Branding tab.
